items.issue: The upload describes women as physically and logically disadvantaged, innately fearful and governed by a single mating mechanism.
items.disposition: Do not generalize or use for advice, capacity judgments or consent inference.

items.issue: The 'hunter traits' model is presented as an evolved attraction code without cited research or competing explanations.
items.disposition: Keep only as Mikey's framework; require primary research and expert review before scientific use.

items.issue: Named celebrity relationships and subcultures are used as proof of attraction mechanisms.
items.disposition: Do not repeat allegations or infer motives from edited public examples without primary verification.

items.issue: Appearance feedback, bullying and parenting are used to predict adult confidence and attraction outcomes.
items.disposition: Treat as possible pathways only; do not diagnose users or families.
